displayName: Animal Shelter VR: Pet Care Simulator
display_name: Animal Shelter VR: Pet Care Simulator
display_long_description:
Welcome to Animal Shelter VR: Pet Care Simulator, a cozy and heartwarming VR animal rescue experience where every pet deserves a second chance.

Rescue abandoned and injured animals as they arrive at your shelter looking for care, comfort, and love. Wash muddy paws, clean dirty fur, feed hungry pets, and help sick or injured animals recover with immersive, hands-on VR interactions.

Meet adorable dogs, playful cats, and other lovable animals with unique personalities. Comfort nervous pets, watch them become happy again, and grow your shelter into the ultimate safe haven for animals in need.

Features

🐾 Rescue and care for adorable animals
🛁 Wash, groom, and clean messy pets
🍖 Feed hungry animals and keep them healthy
🩺 Treat injuries and medical conditions
🏡 Upgrade and decorate your cozy shelter
🎮 Enjoy immersive VR interactions
✨ Watch rescued pets recover and play happily
🌈 Relax in a wholesome and comforting world

Whether you love cozy games, pet simulators, or relaxing VR experiences, Animal Shelter VR: Pet Care Simulator is the perfect place to rescue, heal, and care for furry friends.
